name: Los Angeles SFB
description: Los Angeles SFB is headquarters for Space Systems Command (SSC) and Space Base Delta 3 — a compact urban installation in the South Bay with no flightline. On-base family housing, recreation, and the Fort MacArthur housing annex in San Pedro (~20 miles south) are managed separately from the El Segundo campus.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. All visitors must obtain a pass through the Visitor Control Center at Douglas Street Gate.

gates.name: Douglas Street Gate (Main)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate and main visitor access point. Visitor Control Center (Bldg 260) is located immediately left of the entrance. REAL ID required for visitors.
gates.address: 200 N Douglas St, El Segundo, CA 90245

gates.name: Aviation Boulevard Gate
gates.notes: Closed weekends and federal holidays. Commuter gate for El Segundo campus personnel.
gates.address: 483 N Aviation Blvd, El Segundo, CA 90245

gates.name: Fort MacArthur 24th Street Gate
gates.notes: 24/7 access to Fort MacArthur housing annex. Temporary visitor passes for housing areas issued at gate; may be delayed based on patrol response.
gates.address: 24th St, Fort MacArthur, San Pedro, CA 90731

gates.name: Fort MacArthur 30th Street Gate
gates.notes: 24/7 access to Fort MacArthur housing and community facilities in San Pedro.
gates.address: 30th St, Fort MacArthur, San Pedro, CA 90731

gates.name: Pacific Heights Gate
gates.notes: 24/7 access to Pacific Heights housing area. Restricted to authorized military and DoD ID cardholders and registered visitors.

gates.name: Pacific Crest Gate
gates.notes: 24/7 access to Pacific Crest housing area. Restricted to authorized military and DoD ID cardholders and registered visitors.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Douglas Street Gate)
gates.notes: Issues temporary visitor passes, vehicle passes, and DBIDS credentials. Closed weekends, federal holidays, and family days. Fort MacArthur housing visitor passes issued 24/7 at housing gates.
gates.address: Bldg 260, Douglas Street Gate, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: No Traditional Dining Facility (DFAC)
resources.description: Los Angeles SFB has no traditional military dining facility. Meals are available at the South Bay Bar & Grill, BX food court, and Fort MacArthur Community Center / Harbor View Lounge. Unaccompanied housing residents receive BAS.
resources.address: Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: South Bay Bar & Grill
resources.description: Primary on-base dining at El Segundo — daily breakfast and lunch with hotline meals, made-to-order sandwiches, soup and chili, grab-and-go wraps and salads. Hosts Bites & Brews, trivia, and karaoke events.
resources.address: 483 N Aviation Blvd, Bldg 270, Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: Harbor View Lounge & Café (Community Center)
resources.description: Fort MacArthur community center dining with ocean views — burgers, wings, pizza, barbecue, seafood po-boys, fish tacos, and Friday-night lounge service. Catering available for events and celebrations.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 1100-1400 lunch; Fri lounge 1700-2100; see lafss.com for events
resources.address: 210 W 29th St, Bldg 403, Fort MacArthur, San Pedro, CA 90731

resources.name: BX Food Court
resources.description: Fast food inside the Main Exchange — Burger King, Charleys Philly Steaks, and Starbucks for quick meals on the El Segundo campus.
resources.address: 483 N Aviation Blvd, Bldg 252, Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: Los Angeles SFB Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service AAFES exchange with clothing, electronics, food court, and services for the El Segundo installation.
resources.address: 483 N Aviation Blvd, Bldg 252, Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: Los Angeles SFB Commissary
resources.description: Defense Commissary Agency grocery serving the El Segundo campus and South Bay military community.
resources.address: 483 N Aviation Blvd, Bldg 251, Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: 61st Medical Squadron Clinic (El Segundo)
resources.description: Primary outpatient MTF — family medicine, pediatrics, flight medicine, behavioral health, pharmacy, lab, and immunizations. No emergency department on base.
resources.hours: Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri 0800-1600; Wed 0900-1600; closed weekends and federal holidays
resources.address: 483 N Aviation Blvd, Bldg 210, Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: 61st Medical Squadron Satellite Clinic (Fort MacArthur)
resources.description: Satellite clinic serving Fort MacArthur housing residents and geographically separated personnel in San Pedro.
resources.address: 2400 S Pacific Ave, Bldg 30, Fort MacArthur, San Pedro, CA 90731

resources.name: 61st Dental Squadron
resources.description: General dentistry for active-duty and eligible TRICARE beneficiaries.
resources.address: 483 N Aviation Blvd, Bldg 210, Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: Los Angeles SFB Fitness Center
resources.description: El Segundo fitness center with cardio, strength, free weights, group exercise, racquetball, basketball gym, and running track. Free equipment orientations available. FAC testing Tue-Thu mornings.
resources.address: 483 N Aviation Blvd, Bldg 286, Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: Fort MacArthur Fitness & Sports Center
resources.description: Fitness center at the Fort MacArthur annex — cardiovascular and weight equipment, group fitness room, racquetball courts, gymnasium, locker rooms, and saunas. Equipment checkout available after registration.
resources.address: Fort MacArthur, Bldg 425, San Pedro, CA 90731

resources.name: Fort MacArthur Swimming Pool
resources.description: Seasonal swimming pool at Fort MacArthur. Open on federal holidays when most other FSS facilities are closed.
resources.address: Fort MacArthur, Bldg 400, San Pedro, CA 90731

resources.name: Finance Office (Comptroller)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service for SSC and SBD 3 personnel.
resources.address: Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: Military Personnel Flight (Customer Support / ID Cards)
resources.description: ID cards, DEERS, assignments, promotions, and personnel actions. Closed first Thursday of each month for training.

resources.address: Bldg 272 (Lobby), Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: 61st Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: All MWR programs — dining, fitness, recreation, child care, ITT, and community events across El Segundo and Fort MacArthur.
resources.hours: Facility hours listed on FSS website; closed federal holidays except Fort MacArthur pool
resources.address: 483 N Aviation Blvd, Bldg 270, Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center
resources.description: Relocation, deployment support, financial readiness, newcomers briefing, EFMP family support, and family programs.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0800-1600; closed first Thu monthly for training
resources.address: Bldg 272 (C1-209), Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: Child Development Center
resources.description: Full-day child care for eligible military and DoD families on the El Segundo campus.
resources.address: Bldg 281, Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: School Liaison Program
resources.description: K-12 school transition support, district information, and education resources for families at El Segundo and Fort MacArthur.
resources.address: Bldg 272 (C1-209), Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: Tierra Vista Communities (On-Base Housing)
resources.description: Privatized family housing at Fort MacArthur — apartments, duplexes, townhomes, and single-family homes across Pacific Heights, Pacific Crest, and Fort MacArthur neighborhoods. No on-base housing at El Segundo.
resources.address: 2400 S Pacific Ave, Bldg 410 Suite 4, Fort MacArthur, San Pedro, CA 90731

resources.name: Fort MacArthur Inn (Temporary Lodging)
resources.description: TDY and PCS temporary lodging at Fort MacArthur (~20 miles from El Segundo). No on-base lodging at the El Segundo campus. PCS members have Priority 1 status for up to 30 days.

resources.name: Housing Referral Office (Fort MacArthur)
resources.description: Off-base housing referrals and counseling. All personnel must visit before signing any off-base lease.
resources.address: 2400 S Pacific Ave, Bldg 410, Fort MacArthur, San Pedro, CA 90731

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation & Equipment Rentals
resources.description: Camping gear, sports equipment, picnic area reservations, and adventure trip support at Fort MacArthur.
resources.address: Fort MacArthur, Bldg 425, San Pedro, CA 90731

resources.name: Information, Tickets & Travel (ITT)
resources.description: Discounted theme park tickets, local attractions, travel planning, and recreational trip packages.
resources.address: Bldg 270, Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: Fort MacArthur Community Center
resources.description: Multi-use event venue overlooking San Pedro beaches — parties, weddings, workshops, Independence Day celebrations, and Sno Cone Fridays. Harbor View Event Center reservations available.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 1100-1400 lunch; Fri lounge 1700-2100; events vary
resources.address: 210 W 29th St, Bldg 403, Fort MacArthur, San Pedro, CA 90731

resources.name: Youth Programs (Fort MacArthur)
resources.description: School-age care, teen programs, and youth activities at the Fort MacArthur annex.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri after school; see lafss.com for program schedules
resources.address: Fort MacArthur, Bldg 425, San Pedro, CA 90731

resources.name: No On-Base Golf or Bowling
resources.description: Los Angeles SFB has no golf course or bowling alley on installation. Off-base recreation throughout the greater Los Angeles area; ITT offers discounted local attraction tickets.
resources.address: Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: Chapel Services
resources.description: Protestant, Catholic, and other faith community services at El Segundo (Bldg 272) and Fort MacArthur (Bldg 425).
resources.hours: See chapel bulletin for worship schedules
resources.address: Bldg 272, Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: Visitor Control Center
resources.description: Visitor passes, vehicle passes, and DBIDS credentials for El Segundo campus. Coordinates contractor and vendor access for SSC mission partners.
resources.address: Bldg 260, Douglas Street Gate, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: 61st Security Forces Squadron
resources.description: Base defense, law enforcement, and gate operations for El Segundo and Fort MacArthur annex locations.
resources.address: Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit at the El Segundo campus normal business hours (Mon-Fri 0730-1630). Visit the Military Personnel Flight in Bldg 272 for ID cards and personnel actions. Attend the newcomers briefing at the Military & Family Readiness Center.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: There is no on-base family housing at El Segundo. Permanent housing is at Fort MacArthur (Tierra Vista Communities) and Pacific Heights/Crest neighborhoods in San Pedro. Fort MacArthur Inn offers temporary lodging — book early during PCS season. Visit the Housing Referral Office before signing any off-base lease.

sections.title: Gate Access
sections.body: Douglas Street Gate is open 24/7 and is the main visitor access point. Aviation Boulevard Gate is Mon-Fri 0600-0800 and 1530-1730 only. Fort MacArthur 24th/30th Street gates and Pacific Heights/Crest gates are 24/7 for authorized personnel. Visitor Control Center hours are Mon-Fri 0700-1500. REAL ID required.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus 61st FSS (lafss.com) for dining, fitness, and recreation across El Segundo and Fort MacArthur.
